stories.headline: Radical Redemption's RESURREXION: 15 Years, Live Act & Orchestra
stories.summary: On Nov 28, Radical Redemption celebrates 15 years at Utrecht's Werkspoorkathedraal with a world-premiere live act, a 20-piece orchestra, and two album releases. The deeply personal show, called RESURREXION, also fulfils plans Joey van Ingen made with his late father.

stories.headline: Dimitri K Drops 6 Sets & Secret Show at Sacrifice Day
stories.summary: Dimitri K and MC Robs are gearing up for Sacrifice Day on 28 Nov at Breepark, Breda. Six performances and a mystery new show are planned, plus the Battle of the Elements battle concept.

stories.headline: Devin Wild Drops Melodic 'Serenity' EP in 2026
stories.summary: Dutch artist Devin Wild has released his new five-track 'Serenity' EP, built around a water-and-inner-peace concept. It marks a more melodic shift from his previous experimental projects, reaching up to 175 BPMs.

stories.headline: Digital Punk drops fifth album Into The Fire
stories.summary: Digital Punk released his fifth studio album 'Into The Fire' via Scantraxx, his second full-length in two consecutive years. The project features collabs with Radical Redemption, Adaro, E-Force and more, centered on a mindset of facing challenges head-on.

stories.headline: REBELLiON Indoor 2026 Delivers Raw Chaos
stories.summary: REBELLiON Indoor returned last Saturday with four stages of rawstyle, xtraraw and uptempo action. Standout moments included Infliction LIVE's xtraraw set and The Impulse show by Kruelty and The Smiler.

caption: 15 years of Radical Redemption, Digital Punk's new album, REBELLiON chaos & more — hard dance had a massive week 🔥
